#
# PROVISIONAL. Taken on a shared GitHub Actions runner (AMD EPYC 7763), so the
# noise is the runner's and the figures indicate magnitude only. Produced by
# the bench job of go-decimal-proposal's build.yml, run 41257632216, at
# 32c14fd1b1 on 2026-11-01, with
#   go test -c -o bid.test internal/bid
#   ./bid.test -test.run XXX -test.bench BenchmarkKernel -test.benchmem \
#       -test.count 8 -test.benchtime 100ms
# in the directory src/internal/bid, and the lines below are that output
# unedited. Moving this file is a deliberate commit; see TestBenchRatchet.
#
# The ratchet is TestBenchRatchet, opt-in:
#   go test -run TestBenchRatchet internal/bid -args -bid.ratchet
# It measures each row in short runs and takes the smallest time, as it does
# for the samples below. A row fails when its time is over
#   baseline * (1 + ratchet-band) + ratchet-slack-ns
# or when it allocates. The band is 20% until a quiet baseline exists; the
# slack stands for the timer resolution on rows of about a nanosecond. The
# baseline moves only by a deliberate commit that replaces this file.
#
# ratchet-band: 0.20
# ratchet-slack-ns: 0.5
